name: Juan Rodríguez Martínez — additional son buried 1801
researcher_question: Did Juan Rodríguez Martínez and his wife Marcelina Garcia of Pozuelo, Albacete, Spain have a son also named Juan, who died in infancy in 1801, in addition to the seven children recorded in the tree (b. 1799-1822)?
